comments.content: The syntax for `arraySum` incorrectly says `arrayMax`. It should be `arraySum([func(x[, y1, ..., yN])], source[, cond1, ... , condN])`.
The returned value description for `arrayMax` says "or the minimum element of the lambda results if provided". It should say "maximum".
The "No match" example for `arrayLast` uses `arrayFirst` instead of `arrayLast`. It should be `SELECT arrayLast(x, y -> x=y, [0, 1, 2], [3, 3, 3]) AS res, toTypeName(res)`.
The documentation for `arrayLastIndex` is created but never registered. The call should be `factory.registerFunction<FunctionArrayLastIndex>(documentation_last);`.
